answer.text: Investor education, suitability assessment, KYC, risk profiling

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 4.2.6 and good practices, pre-investment duties: education, suitability, KYC, risk profiling. **The Trap:** Narrow roles miss critical pre-investment duties. **Cross-Exam Context:** Foundational distributor obligations. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Build a structured onboarding workflow covering all four areas.
